package launchpad

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/types"
	"math/big"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRepair37NativeProducer(t *testing.T) {
	p, evm, db := eventState(t)
	type observation struct {
		Name string
		Log  *types.Log
		Args map[string]any
	}
	observations := []observation{}
	for _, name := range []string{"Swap", "PoolStateUpdated", "TokenDeployed", "MarketCreated", "NftMint", "FeeStrategyChanged", "NftTransfer", "PoolRegistered", "RouterTrade", "ConfigUpdated", "FeeFlow", "FeeDistributed"} {
		event := p.abi.Events[name]
		values := []any{}
		expected := map[string]any{"timestamp": "73", "blockNumber": "41"}
		for i, arg := range event.Inputs[:len(event.Inputs)-2] {
			n := byte(i + 1)
			switch arg.Type.String() {
			case "address":
				v := eventAddress(n)
				values = append(values, v)
				expected[arg.Name] = strings.ToLower(v.Hex())
			case "bytes32":
				v := eventHash(n)
				values = append(values, v)
				expected[arg.Name] = "0x" + hex.EncodeToString(v[:])
			case "uint256":
				v := new(big.Int).Add(new(big.Int).Lsh(big.NewInt(1), 192), big.NewInt(int64(n)))
				values = append(values, v)
				expected[arg.Name] = v.String()
			case "uint8":
				values = append(values, n)
				expected[arg.Name] = int(n)
			case "bool":
				values = append(values, true)
				expected[arg.Name] = true
			case "string":
				v := arg.Name + " λ / native family"
				values = append(values, v)
				expected[arg.Name] = v
			default:
				t.Fatalf("uncovered native type %s", arg.Type.String())
			}
		}
		if err := p.emitFamily(evm, name, values...); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		logs := db.GetAllLogs()
		observations = append(observations, observation{name, logs[len(logs)-1], expected})
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(observations)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("REPAIR37_LOGS"), raw, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
